comparison.objective: Insert both air-shroud tabs under a server fan cage and lower the shroud into its seat; candidate screens finishing media.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual large-panel tilt, dual-tab insertion and constrained lowering versus pouring, load sharing and bridge-clearing screen motion.
comparison.success_condition: Both tabs inserted, four corners seated, released and still for 1 s; candidate uses recovery fraction, retention, spill vetoes and a 3 s released dwell.
comparison.reason: The shroud task tests constrained insertion and seating, not size/orientation separation through a mesh.
